epicSummary: Online Bookstore Application Setup and Deployment Foundation
epicDescription: This epic establishes the core technical foundation for the online bookstore application by implementing the Spring Boot framework infrastructure. It ensures the application can start reliably, discover and configure all necessary components automatically, and run as a standalone service without complex setup requirements. This foundation enables rapid deployment and reduces operational complexity while supporting all future bookstore features.

frontend.functional_requirements: Enable users to browse books, search and filter the catalog, view detailed book information, add items to shopping cart, manage cart contents, proceed through checkout process, create and manage user accounts, and view order history. The interface must provide intuitive navigation, real-time feedback on user actions, and seamless integration with backend services for all bookstore operations.
frontend.technical_requirements: Implement using React 18 with TypeScript for type safety and improved developer experience. Use Redux Toolkit for state management of cart, user session, and book catalog data. Integrate Axios for REST API communication with Spring Boot backend. Implement React Router for client-side routing and navigation. Use Material-UI or Tailwind CSS for responsive component styling. Ensure WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility compliance. Implement form validation using React Hook Form. Add error boundary components for graceful error handling. Support JWT token-based authentication with secure token storage.
frontend.devops_requirements: Automate frontend build and deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions. Create multi-stage Docker container for production builds with Nginx for static asset serving. Implement environment-specific configuration management for API endpoints and feature flags. Set up automated testing pipeline including unit tests (Jest), integration tests, and end-to-end tests (Cypress). Deploy to Kubernetes cluster using Helm charts with horizontal pod autoscaling. Configure CDN integration for static assets. Implement monitoring using Google Analytics for user behavior and Sentry for error tracking. Set up automated security scanning for npm dependencies. Configure blue-green deployment strategy for zero-downtime releases.

stories.description: Create the main landing page for the online bookstore with responsive design supporting desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports. Include header with navigation menu, featured books carousel, category browsing section, and footer with links. Implement using React components with Material-UI or Tailwind CSS for styling.

stories.summary: Build book catalog browsing and search interface
stories.description: Develop the book catalog page with grid/list view toggle, pagination, sorting options (price, title, rating), and filtering by category, author, and price range. Integrate search functionality with auto-complete suggestions. Connect to backend REST APIs for book data retrieval.

Implement shopping cart UI with ability to add/remove items, update quantities, view item details, and see real-time price calculations including subtotal, tax, and total. Use Redux for cart state management. Include cart icon in header with item count badge. Persist cart data to localStorage for session continuity.

stories.summary: Develop user authentication and registration forms
stories.description: Create login and registration forms with validation using React Hook Form. Implement JWT token handling for authentication, including secure storage and automatic token refresh. Add password strength indicator and email validation. Integrate with backend authentication APIs. Include forgot password and password reset flows.

stories.summary: Build checkout and order confirmation flow
stories.description: Develop multi-step checkout process including shipping address entry, payment method selection, order review, and confirmation. Implement form validation for address and payment fields. Show order summary with itemized pricing. Display order confirmation page with order number and details after successful purchase.

stories.summary: Implement user profile and order history pages
stories.description: Create user profile page for viewing and editing account information. Develop order history page displaying past orders with filtering and sorting options. Include order detail view showing items, pricing, shipping status, and tracking information.

backend.functional_requirements: Provide robust REST APIs for managing books catalog including CRUD operations, search and filtering capabilities, and inventory tracking. Implement user management with registration, authentication, and profile management. Support shopping cart operations with session management and persistence. Process orders including creation, payment processing, order tracking, and history retrieval. Ensure data integrity, transaction management, and proper error handling across all operations. Provide real-time inventory updates and prevent overselling.
backend.technical_requirements: Develop microservices architecture using Spring Boot 3.x with Java 17+. Implement RESTful APIs following OpenAPI 3.0 specification with Swagger documentation. Use Spring Data JPA with Hibernate for ORM and PostgreSQL as primary database. Implement Redis for caching frequently accessed data (book catalog, user sessions) and shopping cart persistence. Use Spring Security with JWT for stateless authentication and role-based authorization (ADMIN, USER roles). Implement API versioning strategy (/api/v1/). Use Lombok to reduce boilerplate code. Implement proper exception handling with @ControllerAdvice. Use Spring Boot Actuator for health checks and metrics. Implement database migration using Flyway or Liquibase. Follow clean architecture principles with clear separation between controller, service, repository, and entity layers. Implement request/response DTOs with Bean Validation. Use MapStruct for entity-DTO mapping.
backend.devops_requirements: Automate complete CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for build, test, and deployment workflows. Create multi-stage Dockerfiles for optimized container images with security scanning using Trivy. Deploy to Kubernetes cluster using Helm charts with ConfigMaps and Secrets for configuration management. Implement horizontal pod autoscaling based on CPU and memory metrics. Set up PostgreSQL database using StatefulSets or managed database service with automated backups. Deploy Redis cluster for high availability caching. Configure Ingress controller with TLS termination for secure external access. Implement centralized logging using ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or EFK (Fluentd). Set up monitoring and alerting using Prometheus for metrics collection and Grafana for visualization dashboards. Create alerts for API error rates, latency thresholds, database connection pool exhaustion, and pod health. Implement distributed tracing using Jaeger or Zipkin. Set up automated database migration execution during deployment. Configure rolling update strategy with health check probes. Implement GitOps workflow using ArgoCD or Flux for declarative deployments.

stories.summary: Initialize and Bootstrap Spring Boot Application for Online Bookstore
stories.description: Create the main Spring Boot application class with @SpringBootApplication annotation. Implement the main method that invokes SpringApplication.run() to bootstrap the application. This initializes the Spring container, performs auto-configuration, sets up component scanning, configures the embedded servlet container (Tomcat), and prepares the application to handle HTTP requests. Ensure proper package structure and application.properties/application.yml configuration files are in place.

Verify and configure Spring Boot component scanning to automatically discover controllers, services, repositories, and configuration classes across the application package structure. Ensure auto-configuration is properly enabled to automatically configure beans based on classpath dependencies. Configure custom component scan paths if needed and exclude specific auto-configurations if required.

stories.summary: Set up embedded servlet container configuration
stories.description: Configure the embedded Tomcat server with appropriate port settings, context path, and server properties. Implement custom error pages and configure server connection timeouts. Set up HTTPS/TLS configuration for secure communication. Configure compression for response optimization and connection pool settings for optimal performance.

stories.summary: Create Book Management REST API endpoints
stories.description: Develop REST API endpoints for book CRUD operations: GET /api/v1/books (list with pagination, sorting, filtering), GET /api/v1/books/{id} (get single book), POST /api/v1/books (create book - admin only), PUT /api/v1/books/{id} (update book - admin only), DELETE /api/v1/books/{id} (delete book - admin only). Implement search endpoint GET /api/v1/books/search with query parameters for title, author, category, and price range. Include proper request/response DTOs, validation, and error handling.

stories.summary: Implement database integration with Spring Data JPA
stories.description: Set up PostgreSQL database connection configuration in application.properties. Create JPA entity classes for Book, User, Order, OrderItem, and Category with proper relationships and constraints. Develop repository interfaces extending JpaRepository with custom query methods. Configure Hibernate properties for SQL logging, schema validation, and connection pooling. Implement database initialization scripts for development and test environments.

stories.summary: Implement Redis caching for book catalog and sessions
stories.description: Integrate Redis for caching frequently accessed book catalog data to reduce database load and improve response times. Configure Spring Cache abstraction with Redis as cache provider. Implement cache eviction strategies and TTL settings. Use Redis for storing shopping cart data and user session information. Add cache-aside pattern for book queries with appropriate cache keys and expiration policies.

stories.summary: Develop user authentication and authorization with JWT
stories.description: Implement Spring Security configuration with JWT-based stateless authentication. Create endpoints for user registration (POST /api/v1/auth/register), login (POST /api/v1/auth/login), and token refresh (POST /api/v1/auth/refresh). Implement JWT token generation, validation, and parsing. Configure role-based access control with USER and ADMIN roles. Secure API endpoints with method-level security annotations. Implement password encoding using BCrypt.

stories.summary: Create shopping cart management API endpoints
stories.description: Develop REST API endpoints for shopping cart operations: GET /api/v1/cart (get current user's cart), POST /api/v1/cart/items (add item to cart), PUT /api/v1/cart/items/{itemId} (update item quantity), DELETE /api/v1/cart/items/{itemId} (remove item from cart), DELETE /api/v1/cart (clear cart). Implement cart persistence using Redis with user session association. Include cart total calculation and inventory validation.

stories.summary: Implement order processing and management APIs
stories.description: Create REST API endpoints for order management: POST /api/v1/orders (create order from cart), GET /api/v1/orders (get user's order history with pagination), GET /api/v1/orders/{orderId} (get order details), PUT /api/v1/orders/{orderId}/cancel (cancel order). Implement order creation workflow including inventory validation, cart conversion to order, payment processing integration placeholder, and order confirmation. Add order status tracking (PENDING, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED). Ensure transactional integrity for order creation.

stories.summary: Set up API documentation with Swagger/OpenAPI
stories.description: Integrate Swagger UI and OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for all REST endpoints. Configure Springdoc OpenAPI dependency and customize API documentation with descriptions, examples, and response schemas. Document authentication requirements, request/response models, and error codes. Organize endpoints by tags (Books, Users, Cart, Orders). Make Swagger UI accessible at /swagger-ui.html for developer reference.

Integrate Flyway for database schema version control and migration management. Create initial migration scripts for creating tables (books, users, orders, order_items, categories, roles). Implement versioned migration strategy with rollback capabilities. Configure Flyway to run automatically on application startup. Create separate migration scripts for schema changes, reference data, and indexes.

stories.summary: Configure Spring Boot Actuator for monitoring and health checks
stories.description: Enable Spring Boot Actuator and expose health, metrics, and info endpoints. Configure custom health indicators for database connectivity, Redis availability, and external service dependencies. Set up metrics collection for API request counts, response times, and error rates. Secure actuator endpoints with appropriate authentication. Configure Prometheus metrics export format for integration with monitoring stack.
